metadata.name: Ottawa Ankle Rule
metadata.description: Clinical decision rule for deciding if a patient with ankle/midfoot injury needs an X-ray.

indications: Acute blunt injury to the ankle or midfoot.
exclusions: Isolated injury of the skin (superficial lacerations, abrasions, burns)

criteria.text: Bone tenderness at the posterior edge or tip of the lateral malleolus (distal 6 cm)
Bone tenderness at the posterior edge or tip of the medial malleolus (distal 6 cm)
Bone tenderness at the base of the fifth metatarsal
Inability to bear weight both immediately and in the ED (4 steps)

recommendations.positive_ankle: HIGH RISK: Indicated for Ankle X-ray series.
recommendations.positive_foot: HIGH RISK: Indicated for Foot X-ray series.
recommendations.negative: LOW RISK: X-ray is NOT strictly indicated. Treat as sprain/strain. Provide discharge instructions.
